notes.title: Dev Blog - 2023/2024
notes.content:
Hi Everyone !

Here again a small progress-update about Rokatusch.

What's going on?
First of all, I wish you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!

2023 was again a very interesting year. I couldn't work so much on Rokatusch this year, but there was already progress.
In the past few months there have been the first network tests of the Game Lobby and I am currently working on the lobby team settings.

Below are the current version of the lobby (WIP):

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41717937/c7dcebd919c55992a0e2ca7538ec4f556da616d7.png

I will work on loading screen and player logic at the beginning of next year.

What's next?
See the Roadmap draft: noserverstudios.org

Otherwise nice day and greetings
NoserverStudios

notes.title: Dev Blog - Building system
notes.content:
Hi Everyone !

Here again a small progress-update about Rokatusch.
Notice: Since the workers are controlled by AI (Artificial intelligence), there are some delays between the actions (Running, cutting trees and building buildings), so that the whole thing also works performers.

What's going on?
The building system is as good as you can see in the video on the edge.
System: You place a game-pre-defined blueprint somewhere and order that building. You are able to build up this building after that or send workers.

[previewyoutube=Mjo-YhfFpxg;full][/previewyoutube]

What's next?
I will continue with AI logic (Spawn more workers, build village, ...).

Otherwise nice day and greetings
NoserverStudios
